name: forge
description: The `forge` marketplace. Ships one plugin, also called `forge`: 48 command-invoked toolkits spanning WordPress engineering, design and accessibility, writing, DevOps and data, cloud and architecture, security, code cleanup, and documentation and diagrams. Nothing auto-triggers - every tool runs only when its slash command is typed.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Forty-eight command-invoked toolkits in one plugin: WordPress engineering, design and accessibility, writing, DevOps and data, cloud and architecture, security, code cleanup, docs and diagrams. Nothing auto-triggers - every toolkit is reached by an explicit slash command, and each command loads its own procedure file on invocation. Run /forge for a category-then-item picker, or call any command directly.
